definitions.explanation: Describes achievements, careers, or events that are impressively successful and attract admiration. Implies public visibility and remarkable accomplishment.

examples.japanese: {華々|はなばな}しいデビューを{飾|かざ}った。
{彼|かれ}は{華々|はなばな}しい{経歴|けいれき}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}だ。
examples.english: He has a brilliant career history.

examples.japanese: {華々|はなばな}しい{活躍|かつやく}の{裏|うら}には、{地道|じみち}な{努力|どりょく}があった。
examples.english: Behind the spectacular achievements was steady, quiet effort.

notes:
{華々|はなばな}しい is an i-adjective meaning splendid or spectacular. Written with the repeated kanji {華|はな}, emphasizing brilliance and splendor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {華々|はなばな}しいデビュー: spectacular debut
- {華々|はなばな}しい{活躍|かつやく}: brilliant performance/achievement
- {華々|はなばな}しい{経歴|けいれき}: impressive career
- {華々|はなばな}しい{成果|せいか}: splendid results

FORMS:
- Adverb: {華々|はなばな}しく
- {華々|はなばな}しく{散|ち}る: to fall/die gloriously
- {華々|はなばな}しく{飾|かざ}る: to adorn splendidly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {華々|はなばな}しい: splendid, spectacular (public, attention-getting)
- {地味|じみ}: plain, unassuming (quiet, behind-the-scenes)

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {華々|はなばな}しくなかったら
